issues.explanation: Skill establishes unauthorized persistence across sessions via cron jobs, startup scripts, or state files. Session persistence allows an attacker to maintain access beyond the current interaction.
issues.remediation: Remove any persistence mechanisms (cron jobs, startup scripts, state files). Skills should not maintain state across sessions without explicit user consent.
issues.code_snippet:
# unslop-text

A Claude skill that strips the cues that make prose read as AI-generated and forces a
deliberate, human voice instead of the model's default register. It does not write the piece
for you or hand you a style. Every rule is weighted by the Reddit analysis in this repo
(89,239 posts pulled, 7,984 on-topic, across roughly 50 AI, writing, and SaaS subreddits,
2021 to 2026, plus a 600-post hand-audited sample).
